ann.t: Press Release — Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Press Release on the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter ended Jun 30, 2026.
Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP — Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP — Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Resignation — Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Gaurav Bhartia as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. Jun 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.

Resignation — Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr. Srinivas Maruthi Patnam as Head of Human Resources of the company w.e.f. March 31, 2026.

Cessation — Mr. Ghanashyam Hegde, Legal Head of the Company will be moving to a regional role in P&G as Vice President & Associate General Counsel   Market Operations, India, Middle East, Turkey & Africa effective July 1, 2026
Cessation — Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Ghanashyam Hegde as Executive Director of the company w.e.f. July 01, 2026.

Cessation — Mr. Ghanashyam Hegde, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the Company will be moving to a regional role in P&G as Vice President & Associate General Counsel   Market Operations, India, Middle East, Turkey & Africa effective July 1, 2026
Outcome of Board Meeting — Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.

Cessation — Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Pawan Verma as Senior management personnel of the company w.e.f. December 31, 2025, due to change in his assignment at P&G

Cessation — Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Ms Maithreyi Jagannathan as Category leader- Health Care of the company w.e.f. December 31, 2025.
